svg.title: M-02 2 m Boom Layout - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A 2 m boom station and drill layout derived from O3/O5/O6 Rev L. Dimensions and tolerances control.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3/O5/O6 REV L
ALL X VALUES MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY FROM THE FINISHED FRONT END; DO NOT CHAIN LAYOUT.
REAR VALUES ARE NOMINAL FOR L = 30.000; ACTUAL L GOVERNS THE CROSS-CHECK.
J1 / J2: CENTER PAD AND TIE AT MARK; DO NOT DRILL EITHER BOOM.
TRANSFER LINES AT EACH RF STATION.
1. PASS MATERIAL COUPON: 2 m TAPE + SUPPORT.
2. MARK FRONT, REAR, BAND ID, GAIN ARROW.
4. CHECK EACH X FRONT AND X REAR USING L.
6. FIX IN V-BLOCK; DRILL 3 RF HOLES ONLY.
9. RECHECK RF HOLE CENTERS FROM BOTH ENDS.
10. FEED-NODE HOLES ARE IN TAPE, NOT PVC.
1. DIMENSIONS / TOLERANCES CONTROL. VIEW A 1:2 AT 100% PRINT.
2. THREE 7/16 THROUGH-HOLES ONLY. COUPON APPROVAL PRECEDES FINAL DRILLING.
3. ELEMENT CUTS, MOUNTING, FEED HARDWARE, AND RETENTION DETAILS: M-04 TO M-08.
